objective: Notification links that point at no route stop dumping members on the map.
userOutcome: Tapping a changelog announcement opens the changelog instead of silently landing on the map.
successCriteria: Stored notifications with link_url '/changelog' are rewritten to '/settings/changelog'.
Any that survive are redirected client side, so an old row still opens the right page.
The SideQuestPrompt tests no longer leak their seen-flag cookie between cases.
mustPreserve: The empty side quest prompt body requested in issue #254.
nonGoals: No change to which prompts open or what they say.

assumptions.statement: '/settings/changelog' is the only route serving the changelog.
assumptions.impact: Rewriting the stored path sends members to the page they expected.

nextVisibleMilestone: A changelog announcement opens the changelog on cruush.app.
stopConditions: Stop if the server build fails.

job: Fix notification links that resolve to no route.
